title: Proportional Committee Elections with Positive and Negative Votes
abstract: arXiv:2503.01985v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In the classic committee election setting each voter approves a subset of candidates and the goal is to select $k$ winners based on these preferences. A central focus of recent research in the area has been to achieve proportional representation. In this work, we explore notions of proportionality in a more expressive setting that allows voters to vote against candidates---a common feature on online polling platforms and beyond. We propose two conceptually distinct interpretations of negative votes, resulting in different perspectives of proportionality. In the first, preventing the election of disapproved candidates is as important to voters as electing approved ones. In the second, approvals and disapprovals are treated separately, with each receiving its own fairness guarantees. For each approach, we introduce suitable axioms capturing proportionality and examine their satisfiability by appropriate variants of Phragm\'en's r

translated_title: 比例委员会选举中的赞成与反对票
translated_abstract: 在经典的委员会选举设置中，每位选民批准一组候选人，目标是根据这些偏好选出k名获胜者。该领域近期研究的核心焦点是实现比例代表制。在本工作中，我们在更具表现力的设置中探索比例性的概念，该设置允许选民反对候选人——这是在线投票平台及其他领域的常见特征。我们提出了反对票的两种概念性不同解释，导致不同的比例性视角。第一种，阻止不认可的候选人当选对选民而言与选举认可的候选人同等重要。第二种，赞成和反对分别处理，各自获得其公平性保证。针对每种方法，我们引入合适的公理来捕捉比例性，并检验通过Phragmén规则适当变体的可满足性。
tldr: 本文提出两种反对票解释下的比例代表制公理，并验证Phragmén规则变体的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes proportionality axioms under two interpretations of negative votes and examines the satisfiability of Phragmén rule variants.
